assessment.rationale: No open or discoverable solution gives 8,000,000,000 people a free health check every year; the WHO-World Bank UHC Global Monitoring Report 2025 finds 4.6 billion people still lack essential health services (https://www.news-medical.net/news/20251206/Billions-still-lack-essential-health-services-despite-worldwide-gains-in-coverage.aspx). The largest national free check programmes are partial: Indonesia's Cek Kesehatan Gratis (launched February 2025) reached about a quarter of its population in its first year (https://en.antaranews.com/news/403778/free-health-check-program-covers-25-pct-population-in-its-first-year), Vietnam about 30% by July 2026 (https://dtinews.dantri.com.vn/print/20260724161740947.htm), China's free check covers only residents aged 65 and over, and England's NHS Health Check (ages 40-74) had 35% uptake of invitations in 2025/26 (https://www.covermagazine.co.uk/news/4532410/uptake-nhs-health-checks-hits-lowest-level-decade). Honest limit: national free-check models are proven and published; the unsolved part is low-cost, high-uptake delivery at global scale, and a task that only restates a national programme design is not new work.

additionalSearches.query: free annual health check entire population national programme coverage rate
additionalSearches.finding: Whole-population free checks exist only nationally: Indonesia covered about 25% of residents in year one; Vietnam reports about 30.1 million people (29.6%) by July 2026.

additionalSearches.query: WHO universal health coverage service coverage index 2025 billions lack essential health services
additionalSearches.finding: UHC Global Monitoring Report 2025: 4.6 billion people lack essential services; service coverage index 71 of 100 in 2023, projected 74 by 2030. The global KPI is far from met.

additionalSearches.query: NHS Health Check uptake percentage eligible invited 40-74
additionalSearches.finding: England's NHS Health Check (ages 40-74, five-yearly): 3.8 million invited in 2025/26, 35% took it up, the lowest in over a decade. Even a rich-country programme misses annual universal coverage.

additionalSearches.query: China free annual physical examination elderly 65 national basic public health service number examined
additionalSearches.finding: China's national basic public health service offers a free yearly check only to residents aged 65 and over; age-limited and one country.
